Attached: 2 images

SmartGit 26.2 adds Claude and Codex agent integration 🎉, built specifically around Git rather than as a general coding environment.

Each agent session runs in its own isolated branch, so multiple agents can work on different tasks in parallel without conflicts.

SmartGit automatically provides the relevant Git context (commits, branches, history), and everything stays local and under your review — start, steer, accept, or discard.

This is the first iteration; feedback on where the Git integration should go next is welcome.

#Git #SmartGit #AIAgents #DevTools #Claude #Codex
